items.title: Free Laptop Scheme For Students
items.snippet_en: The claim that the Indian government is providing free laptops to all students under the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is false. These viral messages are scams designed to collect personal information. Some Indian states have their own laptop or tablet distribution programs for eligible students.

items.title: Fact Check: Is govt offering free laptops or ₹25,000 to students?
items.snippet_en: The claim that the Indian government is providing free laptops to all students under the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is false. outputs.notes_en: The 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is a fraudulent scheme. The Indian government has not announced any such program. The link provided is also part of the scam, designed to collect personal information. While some states have their own laptop distribution schemes, there is no central government scheme.
